chapterInfo.content:
17
Ɔkasa mu nyansa ne nkwaseasɛm
1 # Mmb 15.16-17; 16.8 Kɔntɔmoa wesee a asomdwoeɛ wɔ mu yɛ
sene efie a afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔko ho ayɛ no ma.
2Akoa nimdefoɔ bɛdi ɔba a ɔyɛ aniwudeɛ so,
na ɔbɛnya agyapadeɛ mu kyɛfa wɔ anuanom mu.
3 # Dwom 66.10 Kyɛmferɛ wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ, na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sika,
na deɛ ɔsɔ akoma hwɛ ne AWURADE.
4Ɔdebɔneyɛni tie ahuhudeɛ ano,
ɔtorofoɔ yɛ aso ma mmusubɔ tɛkyerɛma.
5 # Mmb 14.31 Deɛ ɔyi ohiani ahi gu ne yɛfoɔ anim ase,
deɛ n’ani gye amaneɛ ho no, ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
6 # Dwom 128.6 Nkɔkoraa abotire ne mma mma,
na mma animuonyam ne wɔn agyanom.
7Kasantrasoɔ mfata ogyegyentwie,
na nkantom sɛ atorɔ ano bɛfata ɔdehyeɛ.
8Ayɛyɛ te sɛ aboɔden boɔ wɔ deɛ ɔnya no ani so,
baabiara a ɛfa no ɛma no yɛ yie.
9Deɛ ɔkata mfomsoɔ soɔ no hwehwɛ ɔdɔ,
na deɛ ɔti asɛm mu no tete nnamfo ntam.
10Nkaanim hyɛne nhunumufoɔ mu
kyɛne sɛ wɔbɔ ɔkwasea mmaa ɔha.
11Atuateɛ nko na ɔbɔne rehwehwɛ,
na wɔbɛsoma ɔbɔfoɔ tirimuɔdenfoɔ akɔ ne so.
12Ma osisire a wɔafa ne mma nhyia wo mmom,
na ɛnyɛ ɔkwasea n’agyimisɛm mu.
13 # Dwom 109.5 Deɛ ɔde bɔne hyɛ papa ananmu no,
bɔne rempa ne fie da.
14Ntɔkwa mfitiaseɛ te sɛ nsuo ano tue,
enti ɔham mu nnya nyɛɛ den no, gyae.
15 # Yes 5.23 Deɛ ɔbu ɔbɔnefoɔ bem ne deɛ ɔbu ɔteneneeni fɔ no,
AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn baanu nyinaa.
16Adɛn nti na sika wɔ ɔkwasea nsam,
sɛ ɔde bɛtɔ nyansa, berɛ a ɔnni tire?
17 # Mmb 18.24 Adamfo dɔ berɛ nyinaa mu,
na onua, wɔwoo no maa ahohiahia.
18 # Mmb 6.1 Onipa a ɔnni tire na ɔdi akagyinamu,
na ɔdi ne ɔhɔhoɔ agyinamu.
19Deɛ ɔpɛ ntɔkwa no pɛ mmarato,
deɛ ɔma ne dan ano korɔn mmorosoɔ no hwehwɛ n’ankasa ne pira.
20Akoma mu kontonkyifoɔ nhunu papa,
na tɛkyerɛma danedanefoɔ hwe bɔne mu.
21 # Mmb 10.1 Deɛ ɔwo ɔkwasea no, ɔwo nya awerɛhoɔ,
na anigyeɛ biara nni hɔ mma ogyegyentwie agya.
22 # Mmb 15.13, 15 Anigyeɛ akoma yɛ aduro pa,
na honhom a ɛdi yea no deɛ, ɛwe nnompe mu.
23Ɔbɔnefoɔ gye ayɛyɛdeɛ firi kokoam,
sɛ ɔrebɛdane atemmuo akwan ani.
24 # Mmb 4.25 Nyansa wɔ nhunumufoɔ anim,
na ɔkwasea deɛ, n’ani da asase ano nohoa.
25 # Mmb 17.21 Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’agya awerɛhoɔ
ne ne na a ɔwoo no bɔnwono.
26Sɛ wɔgye ɔteneneeni hɔ mmaratodeɛ a, ɛnyɛ,
na sɛ wɔhwe adɛɛfoɔ a, ɛnyɛ koraa.
27 # Mmb 10.19; Yak 1.19 Deɛ ɔdodo ne nsɛm ho hunu nimdeɛ,
na deɛ ne honhom dwoɔ yɛ nhunumu nipa.
28 # Hiob 13.5 Ogyimifoɔ mpo, ɔmua n’ano a, wɔbu no nyansafoɔ,
aane, deɛ ɔka n’ano tom no, ɔyɛ nhunumuni.

pageProps.chapterText:
Kɔntɔmoa wesee a asomdwoeɛ wɔ mu yɛ
sene efie a afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔko ho ayɛ no ma.
Akoa nimdefoɔ bɛdi ɔba a ɔyɛ aniwudeɛ so,
na ɔbɛnya agyapadeɛ mu kyɛfa wɔ anuanom mu.
Kyɛmferɛ wɔ hɔ ma dwetɛ, na fononoo wɔ hɔ ma sika,
na deɛ ɔsɔ akoma hwɛ ne AWURADE.
Ɔdebɔneyɛni tie ahuhudeɛ ano,
ɔtorofoɔ yɛ aso ma mmusubɔ tɛkyerɛma.
Deɛ ɔyi ohiani ahi gu ne yɛfoɔ anim ase,
deɛ n’ani gye amaneɛ ho no, ne ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
Nkɔkoraa abotire ne mma mma,
na mma animuonyam ne wɔn agyanom.
Kasantrasoɔ mfata ogyegyentwie,
na nkantom sɛ atorɔ ano bɛfata ɔdehyeɛ.
Ayɛyɛ te sɛ aboɔden boɔ wɔ deɛ ɔnya no ani so,
baabiara a ɛfa no ɛma no yɛ yie.
Deɛ ɔkata mfomsoɔ soɔ no hwehwɛ ɔdɔ,
na deɛ ɔti asɛm mu no tete nnamfo ntam.
Nkaanim hyɛne nhunumufoɔ mu
kyɛne sɛ wɔbɔ ɔkwasea mmaa ɔha.
Atuateɛ nko na ɔbɔne rehwehwɛ,
na wɔbɛsoma ɔbɔfoɔ tirimuɔdenfoɔ akɔ ne so.
Ma osisire a wɔafa ne mma nhyia wo mmom,
na ɛnyɛ ɔkwasea n’agyimisɛm mu.
Deɛ ɔde bɔne hyɛ papa ananmu no,
bɔne rempa ne fie da.
Ntɔkwa mfitiaseɛ te sɛ nsuo ano tue,
enti ɔham mu nnya nyɛɛ den no, gyae.
Deɛ ɔbu ɔbɔnefoɔ bem ne deɛ ɔbu ɔteneneeni fɔ no,
AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn baanu nyinaa.
Adɛn nti na sika wɔ ɔkwasea nsam,
sɛ ɔde bɛtɔ nyansa, berɛ a ɔnni tire?
Adamfo dɔ berɛ nyinaa mu,
na onua, wɔwoo no maa ahohiahia.
Onipa a ɔnni tire na ɔdi akagyinamu,
na ɔdi ne ɔhɔhoɔ agyinamu.
Deɛ ɔpɛ ntɔkwa no pɛ mmarato,
deɛ ɔma ne dan ano korɔn mmorosoɔ no hwehwɛ n’ankasa ne pira.
Akoma mu kontonkyifoɔ nhunu papa,
na tɛkyerɛma danedanefoɔ hwe bɔne mu.
Deɛ ɔwo ɔkwasea no, ɔwo nya awerɛhoɔ,
na anigyeɛ biara nni hɔ mma ogyegyentwie agya.
Anigyeɛ akoma yɛ aduro pa,
na honhom a ɛdi yea no deɛ, ɛwe nnompe mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ gye ayɛyɛdeɛ firi kokoam,
sɛ ɔrebɛdane atemmuo akwan ani.
Nyansa wɔ nhunumufoɔ anim,
na ɔkwasea deɛ, n’ani da asase ano nohoa.
Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’agya awerɛhoɔ
ne ne na a ɔwoo no bɔnwono.
Sɛ wɔgye ɔteneneeni hɔ mmaratodeɛ a, ɛnyɛ,
na sɛ wɔhwe adɛɛfoɔ a, ɛnyɛ koraa.
Deɛ ɔdodo ne nsɛm ho hunu nimdeɛ,
na deɛ ne honhom dwoɔ yɛ nhunumu nipa.
Ogyimifoɔ mpo, ɔmua n’ano a, wɔbu no nyansafoɔ,
aane, deɛ ɔka n’ano tom no, ɔyɛ nhunumuni.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
